corrections.original: In July 2026 the learned interpreter reported 0/20 on both tasks (key claim 1; timeline row 'July 2026'; summary lists it with lab round one)
corrections.fix: The repo calls it 'The previous report' and never dates it. lab/learned-interpreter first appears in commit c6bf933 (2026-09-03), and the July round one (a137ccd, 2026-07-08) has four experiments and no learned interpreter. Say 'an earlier report' (before 2026-09-03), not 'July'. The 0/20 -> 20/20 at x1,000,000 result is confirmed.

corrections.original: Summary: the recovery experiment was 'a failure by its own pre-registered rule on TOML and on a bison-generated LR table, rescued only by fairer starts measured on validation data'
corrections.fix: Only TOML carries the explicit 'By the rule fixed beforehand the track failed' verdict, from a final test that ran once. On bison, gradient descent alone 'did not carry over' on validation data, and the final test has not run. On TOML's final test, gradient descent + trial and error with TOML mistakes in the data reached the hand rules (98.3/82.7 vs 98.7/81.7). So the rescue was not only through validation-data fairer starts.

corrections.original: Trial-and-error search, or training with TOML mistakes in the data, brought it level with the hand-written rules (key claim 12)
corrections.fix: It took the combination: 'With trial and error, and with TOML mistakes in the training data, the result is level with the hand-written rules' (98.3/82.7 vs 98.7/81.7). Trial and error alone on random damage reached 93.8/46.3, above the one-rule baseline (89.8/37.9) but well below the hand rules.

corrections.original: 'The trained parser beat hand-written rules' is true only for JSON, familiar mistakes, chars right
corrections.fix: On JSON's final test the trained parser won on familiar mistakes on both measures (98.1/79.8 vs 96.6/79.6) and on characters for agent-written payloads (85.6 vs 82.7). The rules won on the 4 unseen types on both measures (98.9/87.2 vs 97.1/68.9) and on agent-written whole payloads (56.7 vs 46.3). 'Trained' is the mean of 5 runs.
